name: M³-AVM: Multimodal Multi-Model Abstract Virtual Machine
description: Deterministic virtual machine prototype in Rust for sparse event-driven tensor computation: ISA v1.4 with 32-byte instructions, strict-priority scheduler with absolute deadlines, CoW snapshot/rollback (FORK/ABORT), CSR sparse tensors, Q4_K fused AVX2 matvec, GGUF mmap inference with per-layer KV cache, and Lean 4 proofs. Cluster, 64-byte forms, composite deadlines and cross-model transfer are reserved future work.
